items.stem: In a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) app, what is the role of embeddings?

options.text: To represent text as vectors so semantically similar passages can be retrieved
options.rationale: Correct: embeddings enable similarity search over content.

options.text: To permanently retrain the model on the documents
options.rationale: RAG retrieves context; it does not retrain the model.
Embeddings are not an encryption mechanism.

options.text: To replace the need for a model
options.rationale: A generative model is still required to produce the answer.

items.stem: Which TWO are responsible practices before shipping a GenAI assistant? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Create an evaluation set and measure output quality
options.rationale: Correct: evaluation catches regressions and errors.

options.text: Apply safety filters to inputs and outputs
options.rationale: Correct: safety controls reduce harmful responses.

options.text: Remove all logging to hide failures
options.rationale: Hiding failures is irresponsible and harmful.

options.text: Let the model answer with no grounding to save effort

items.explanation: Correct: evaluation and safety filtering are responsible practices.

items.stem: Which approach most directly reduces hallucinated facts in an answer?

options.text: Grounding the model in retrieved source passages
options.rationale: Correct: grounding supplies factual context to draw from.
Higher temperature increases variability, not factuality.

options.text: Asking the model to be more confident
options.rationale: Confidence wording does not improve factual accuracy.
